title: View mode only changes the look, not what the user is allowed to do
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view and Work orders View and Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and add a new line.
  2. Edit the allowed fields on the new line.
  3. Save.
custom_expected: The user can still edit and save at the data level; only the look of the interface is simpler.
evidence: UI/enforcement: tech view is purely presentational — the tech-view role retains workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit and can add lines (New Line functional on the lines screen); data-level create/edit is governed by CRUD perms, not the view mode (estimate column renders as hours but edit capability persists).
